blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Government workers who have reached 56 years of age and have completed at least 15 years of service may soon be able to retire and still keep retirement benefits as the House of Representatives approved on third and final reading a bill on the matter. During the session on Tuesday, House Bill (HB) No. 10995, which seeks to amend Republic Act No. 8291 or the Government Service Insurance Act of 1997, was approved after 209 members present voted in the affirmative, with no negative votes and abstentions.
